verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says users can comment directly on text or images in issue descriptions, which matches the story's text-and-image inline commenting on an item's description. The evidence is a single one-line changelog entry with no deeper documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how inline comments work (threading, resolution, whether they persist when text is edited, coverage of project/document descriptions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description

citations.quote: You can now comment directly on text or images in issue descriptions.
